# Core tests that fail on GitHub's hosted runners for timing reasons only.
#
# The hosted "Linux · core" shards leave these out; the advisory job "Linux ·
# core (timing-sensitive)" runs them alone, one at a time, on every run that
# runs Core, and its failures do not fail "Linux · core". Local gates and
# `tools/mg core-test` still run every test. Each failure stays tracked in
# docs/process/verification-status.md ("Hosted Core timing-sensitive tests").
#
# One test per line, as nextest prints it: `<binary id> <test name>  # reason`.
# When a test is fixed, delete its line: the shards then run it again.
